text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.3.1 -> 5% traffic (eu-west). change window 2025-08-15 02:00-05:00 UTC. canary instances: 20. rollout id r-20250815-17. post stop/go in thread. /deploy status
maria: seeing a small spike in eu-west 5xxs on the canary — ~0.8% vs baseline 0.05% :eyes:
ajay: can you paste the metrics link?
maria: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/r-20250815-17 — 95p latency +120ms, error traces show kv-cache misses and a short OOM on node-eu5-03
ops-lead: can we reduce to 2% and watch? don't want a full rollback if it's a single host flare
tim: i'd vote hold at 5% while ops drains the host. rollback (pin to v2.3.0) is staged if needed
sophie: ops, can you cordon/drain node-eu5-03 and reroute? if drain good we can continue but bump slower
ops: drain started on node-eu5-03 — cordon + evicting pods. command: `kubectl cordon node-eu5-03 && kubectl drain node-eu5-03 --ignore-daemonsets` (taking ~45s)
deploy-bot: drain complete. observability: error rate dropped to 0.09%, 95p latency back to +20ms. recommend resume. :thumbsup:
ajay: agree resume but slow bump — go to 7% (not 10%). hold 10m with watch
maria: ack. i'll tail kv-cache metrics and app logs for any OOM regressions
ops-lead: consensus: slow bump -> go to 7%. tim, please have rollback path ready (pin v2.3.0). trigger condition: error >0.5% or 95p > +200ms -> rollback
tim: rollback path ready: `service.set_traffic(tag=v2.3.0)` — docs + pre-approved rollback runbook on #release-notes
deploy-bot: traffic adjusted to 7%. canary id r-20250815-17. next checkpoint in 10m. :rocket:
sophie: thanks — i'll be on watch. ping me directly @sophie if anything spikes.
